title: Austin Bond Election Scheduled
summary:
*   **Voter Decision on Bonds:** An election was ordered to decide on the authorization of Revenue Bonds and General Obligation Bonds, which are used for city projects and services.
*   **Election Date Set:** This bond election will take place on November 3, 1998.
*   **Approval Vote:** The ordinance to hold the election passed with a 5-2 vote among the attending members.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
August 17, 1998
Mayor Watson called the meeting to order, noting the presence of all Councilmembers.
Approve an Ordinance ordering an election to authorize the issuance of Revenue Bonds and
General Obligation Bonds.
Ordinance No. 980817-A approved a November 3, 1998 election date on Mayor Pro Tern
Garcia's motion, Councilmember Slusher's second, 5-2 vote, Councilmembers Griffith and
Lewis voting "NO".
ADJOURNED at 9:50 a.m. on Concilmember Griffith's motion, Councilmember Slusher's second,
7-0 vote.
Approved on this the 26th day of August, 1998 on Councilmember Spelman's motion,
Councilmember Slusher's second, 4-0-1 vote, Mayor Pro Tern Garcia abstaining,
Councilmember Griffith off the dais, Councilmember Griffith absent.
